program.soLenCapSource: Solana's MAX_PERMITTED_DATA_LENGTH 10,485,760 B bounds the ProgramData; max_len = round_up(1.25 x so_len, 4096) reaches it at so_len 8,388,608. No L(kind) table bounds this lane: every lane client requests the 64 MiB runtime loaded-data limit (local-play-act.mjs LOCAL_ACT_LOADED_LIMIT, flocalplay-reveal.mjs LOCAL_REVEAL_BUDGET).
program.minSolanaCli: 4.0.0 (plan.mjs MIN_SOLANA_CLI): the CLI verifies the ELF with its own syscall table before sending, and 3.1.x does not know sol_curve_decompress / sol_curve_pairing_map. The build stays on cargo-build-sbf 3.1.9.
program.features: devnet-playable-sbf = conquest-dispatch-experimental + land-preview (the land lane localnet-land-sbf without the [0x45; 32] id check)

rent.why: MEASURED on devnet 2026-11-18 20:40 JST by the devnet-readonly-checks run (read-only public RPC, no key, no transaction; reports/devnet-readonly-checks.md, DRAFT PR #52, which also records it in devnet-profile.json's "measured" block): 5080 lamports per byte (SIMD-0437-2 active since epoch 1141; 2575/1322/696 and SIMD-0438's reset to 6960 inactive). It reproduced (128 + len) x 5080 for 16 sizes, including the conquest lane's ProgramData 4,485,165 B = 22.78528844 SOL. The rate can change at an epoch boundary: read it again right before a deploy and pass --rate if it moved.

fees.writeChunkNote: bytes per loader-v3 Write transaction. With a fee payer and a separate upgrade (= buffer) authority the CLI's calculate_max_chunk_size leaves about 876 B [derived from agave v3.1.9 cli/src/program.rs, not run]; 850 is the conservative figure (fewer bytes = more transactions = a higher estimate). Each Write carries two signatures: the fee payer's and the authority's.

lamportsNotes.creationBond: frontier_abi::presets::MIN_CREATION_BOND, returned after a normal season (burned on a post-round pre-join abort, I-09)
lamportsNotes.pfundInitial: S1_DEVNET_WIDE_7D = frontier_abi::v2::presets::PFUND_DEVNET_WIDE (36 SOL, 6 SOL per wedge fund). OpenRing / WideRequestRingSeed check that every wedge fund holds d x rent(province) above its own rent (a balance check, not a spend): ring 128 needs 128 x rent(4,736) = 3.163 SOL and wide ring 129 needs 129 x rent(4,864) = 3.271 SOL per fund at 5,080 lamports/byte (4.333 / 4.482 SOL at 6,960). The rest pays for the provinces actually opened (24,709,120 lamports each legacy, 25,359,360 wide, at 5,080). Float.

lamportsNotes.keeperDelayPools: 2 keepers x 32 payers x up to 2 x delay_floor 0.05 SOL (PLAYTEST-RUNBOOK 4)
lamportsNotes.feesAndTipsPer50Players: PLAYTEST-RUNBOOK 5: <= 2.5 SOL per 200 players-week, scaled to 50 (spent)

season.note: S1_DEVNET_WIDE_7D (frontier-abi/src/v2/presets.rs; devnet-preset-wide, D-1 of verifier-wide-instrs): S1_LOCAL_7D with r_max_ceiling 128, theta 1 bp early/late, pfund_initial 36 SOL and (Q-W1, 2026-11-20) outpost_tier_min 0 (a rim Hamlet first village anchors a wide claim), so the legacy map can grow one ring per bell to ring 128 (~21 h from genesis ring 3) and the wide land (ring 129+) can be requested; S1_LOCAL_7D's map ends at ring 16 and no wide instruction but WideSetRules could ever land there. Provinces past the genesis rings are opened on demand only (keeper lazy_provinces = true): opening every province to ring 128 would cost 49,537 x 24,709,120 lamports = 1,224 SOL. The natural local world (itest natural_play.rs) still creates its Season from S1_LOCAL_7D with program_version 0x4804. frontier-operator --preset S1_DEVNET_WIDE_7D creates the 0x4804 season (B3; loopback-tested on the devnet .so), and the verifier cannot PASS a 0x4804 season's wide instructions (Q16-1).

operator.note: frontier-operator --preset S1_DEVNET_WIDE_7D (frontier-node/crates/stack, built --features playable-lane; devnet blocker B3) reads this block with rpcUrl, allowedRpcHosts, refusedRpcHostPatterns, programId, upgradeAuthority, rent.assume, season.preset, program.programVersion and program.required/refusedMarkers. seasonId: the Season PDA id AnnounceSeason uses (never reusable). beacon: quicknet (the devnet build has no test beacon). The setup is AnnounceSeason, the 24 h lead, CreateSeason, InitBeaconLogs, InitShards x 6, then WideSetRules once keeper A has seeded the season (DEVNET-DEPLOY-RUNBOOK section 6b).

ringsDuty.why: S1_DEVNET_WIDE_7D grows the map one ring per bell to the legacy rim (r_max_ceiling 128) so the wide land (ring 129+) can be requested; lazy_provinces opens the genesis rings whole and every later ring without its provinces (they open on demand). Only the rings keeper (A) needs it.
ringsDuty.rimWhy: Owner decision Q-W1 (2026-11-20 t398u): on this wide season a player's FIRST village may also be founded on the rim (rings 126-128, beside the wide land), as in local wide play. PlaceHome cannot name a province past the base r_max 16, so a rim first village is a one-site FileTicket; lazy_provinces leaves the rim without provinces, so once ring 128 is opened and seeded the rings duty opens the ring-128 provinces beside the middle 6 ring-129 provinces of each wedge (keeper::rings::rim_plan, the local wide world's rim): 42 provinces, 24,709,120 lamports of rent each from the wedge funds (1.038 SOL of the 36 SOL float at 5,080 lamports/byte, 1.422 SOL at 6,960; every fund still covers ring 129's balance check), about 140,000 CU each (measured offline, stack/tests/operator_playable.rs P4).
ringsDuty.wideWhy: Devnet runbook gap P6 (closed in code, loopback test only): once ring 128 is seeded the rings duty opens the wide rings 129, 130 and 131 one at a time, each a bell after the previous one opened (the program's rule): WideRequestRingSeed (its 192-byte record 1,625,600 lamports of rent at 5,080 lamports/byte, 2,227,200 at 6,960, from keeper A's payer), WideConsumeRingSeed on the round the request bound (the beacon path: the drand port, BLS-verified by the program), then WideOpenProvince for the middle 6 provinces of each wedge's arc (keeper::rings::wide_plan, the local wide world's plan; every rim village is within outpost_range of a ring-129 one): 108 provinces, 25,359,360 lamports each from the wedge funds (2.739 SOL of the 36 SOL float at 5,080, 3.752 SOL at 6,960; every fund still clears ring 131's balance check, 3.32 / 4.55 SOL). Needs keeper A built with --features playable-lane. Measured offline (stack/tests/operator_playable.rs P5): request about 15,400 CU, consume about 331,000 CU, open 476,712-538,387 CU.

keeperA.rolesWhy: tickets (Q-W1): settles every open FileTicket on its bell's seed (SettleTicket, class D) -- the rim first villages; the beacon role posts that seed (PostAnchor / PostSeed from the live quicknet rounds). Measured offline (P4): SettleTicket 21,306 CU. wide-tickets (P7, closed in code, loopback test only; needs keeper A built with --features playable-lane): settles every open wide claim (0xD9 WideClaimSite) once its bell's seed is on chain (WideSettleTicket 0xDC, one per wide site in the lottery order, the displacing form when someone settled out of order; expired after 24 bells) and finalizes every provisional wide village once the program's own finality rule holds (WideFinalize 0xDF); fees only (the village's rent comes from the claim's escrow). Measured offline (P5): WideSettleTicket 21,410 CU, WideFinalize 6,424 CU. reveal, settle-departure, gather, resolve, skip, settle, close, claims (devnet-page-war; the S1 playtest keeper A's play roles, keeper/src/play.rs): the LEGACY war of the page's sealed marches (ring <= 128) -- SettleDeparture once the origin resolved past the departure, the Reveal of every sealed march from the public round T(arrive) (the seal opens for anyone once that round is out) or from the owner's material the page hands over (POST /gw/f/reveal -> /v1/reveal), never at or after A + W - 2 slots, GatherClash / ResolveFromInputs of the arrival bells and every contested keep bell, SkipQuiet of the quiet bells of every opened province (so that Muster and Depart stay resident), SettleTransit (the host routed, stood or home), the return settles, the closes and the keeper's own late-reveal claims; class D/W/N fees only. Measured offline: operator_playable P8 (MEASURED_P8).
